# Copilot Instructions

Primary instructions are in `/AGENTS.md` at the vault root — that is the single source of truth for this vault. Read that file first, then `99-System/PROFILE.md` for context on the vault owner.

Do not duplicate rules here. This file previously held its own copy of the vault structure, templates, and workflow, which drifted out of sync with `/AGENTS.md` (wrong folder for courses, a Daily Note format that didn't match any real template, and a review rule that sent finished notes to Archive instead of `40 Knowledge/`). That caused real damage — notes ended up in the wrong place. Keep this file a pointer, nothing more.
